registration: Local protocol fixed before the first run of these conditions; not an external preregistration.
question: Does the existing scripted planner contribute anything that the direct stock-sale rule cannot preserve?
primary_metric: native payout to the controlled faction
diagnostic_metric: final treasury; not interchangeable with payout
controllers: Frozen A/B/C/D policies, plus direct-rule controls E/F with the respective context. No tuning after observing outcomes.
equivalence: All 36 planner-versus-rule pairs must have identical decisions, native action receipts and settlement, matched initial conditions and zero invalid controlled actions.
falsifier: Any mismatched decision or settlement rejects exact equivalence and requires investigation. A payout gain alone cannot establish a human hiring need.
challenge: For each of the 18 conditions, compare E against a fixed direct-rule variant that skips Market in round 2 and otherwise sells all. It has the same own-state information. A higher payout refutes payout optimality of immediate sale in the tested condition; a treasury gain alone is diagnostic. This variant is another rule, not evidence for an expert role.
cost: Measure task-setup tool calls, model tokens and setup milliseconds separately from game execution. Do not infer human wages, maintenance cost or economic ROI.
stopping: One fixed run of all 18 conditions for six controllers, plus 18 challenge games. Retain every result; do not select seeds or tune policies using this batch. Later reruns are reproducibility checks, not fresh holdouts.
limit: Deterministic scripted game policies only. The planner sets inventory_review once before games; it does not adapt during games. Adaptive expertise and real team hiring remain not_validated.
